source_title: What's up with traffic/CATA this sem?
post_title: What's up with traffic/CATA this sem?
post_body:
what's up with traffic/CATA this sem?

Might be the traffic but CATA buses are almost always 10-15 minutes late, even the express buses. When I get to the bus stop, they are on time, and as time goes on the delays just increase. Traffic/CATA wasn't this shit during the spring.
A few days ago, 4 white loop buses were all running 200 feet apart from each other
Its been like this for years. The best is when you get 3 BLs and 2 RLs all within 2 minutes of each other going east on Curtain.
CATA is losing about a third of its funding because the state senate majority leader can't remove his head from his ass and is defunding transit statewide because he's a drunk petulant child
a long time ago, in a time when people had a functional education, they realized that moving a lot of people at the same time in a single vehicle on a fixed line and schedule was the most efficient, and frankly only way to move a large volume of people in and out of cities and towns
and when those systems became unprofitable, people realized it was going to be catastrophic to whole regions if they were to no longer function. so people said "hey maybe we should all band together to make sure the place we live doesn't turn into a giant fuckpile of traffic and emissions and lose all commerce and movement" and decided they'd all collectively fund it.
seems logical, right?
Part of the trouble is they don't allow much time for boarding and unboarding in the timetables. Combine that with a little bit of traffic, and you can see how the buses get way off schedule during peak hours.
Yeah, new people haven't learned the "move all the way back" rule. Busses will be gummed up while people learn bus etiquette, and traffic will be gummed up until people learn traffic patterns/parking/stop going to class once the weather gets bad.
It varies depending on the time of the year and whats going on. People are getting back from labor day and parents love to act like the bus stops are fair game for parking as long as they put their four ways on. Thats what id chalk it up to tbh, they have 3 busses running for each loop. Last year it was 2, so the only cause for delays would be external ones.
Pretty sure I overheard one of the Bloop drivers saying they individually decide how much time to wait at certain stops, not sure if thats the same for Woop
author: manual_import
